name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid when relisting a property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid when relisting a property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid relisting with the same price and presentation if they didn't work before; this rarely yields different results. Also, don't ignore buyer feedback from the initial listing period. A common pitfall is failing to address identified shortcomings. Our agents help you analyze feedback, adapt your strategy, and ensure your property stands out in competitive markets, from Coconut Grove to Doral.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid relisting without changing price or presentation, and don't ignore previous buyer feedback to improve your strategy.
